name: Heed My Call
summary: A shaman calls you to the steam pools of Thousand Needles, where corrupted totems can draw out the quilboar’s elementals. The Razormane will resist your interference.

sections.title: At the Steam Pools
sections.body: The steam pools hold fire, earth, water, and air, making them a fitting place for the defenses. A shaman asks you to set twisted totems there and prepare for the Razormane to resist. The corruption around the totems is meant to summon the quilboar’s elementals.

sections.title: The Elements Answer
sections.body: The shaman feels the ritual's storm and asks whether you have dispersed it. Once you do, the breeze carries word of victory, and the elements have granted you their respect.

faq.answer: The pools hold fire, earth, water, and air, so the shaman considers them suitable for defenses.

faq.q: What are the twisted totems for?
faq.answer: Their corruption is meant to summon the quilboar’s elementals.
The Razormane quilboar are expected to resist your interference.

faq.q: What does the shaman ask me to do?
faq.answer: The shaman asks you to place twisted totems at the Thousand Needles steam pools and put an end to the quilboar ritual.

attribution: In-game quest text: Heed My Call
